lines.en: label yumidorm10:
Once again, I find myself knocking on the door of a girl who wants nothing to do with me.
lines.zh: 又一次，我发现自己在敲一个对我避之唯恐不及的女孩的门。

lines.en: But, for reasons beyond my comprehension, I’m drawn to her. Like she’s a flickering light and I’m a...moth or some other fitting metaphor.
lines.zh: 可出于我无法理解的原因，我被她吸引着。就像她是一盏闪烁的灯，而我是……一只飞蛾，或者别的什么贴切的比喻。

lines.en: Why do I feel the need to get poetic all of a sudden? This is Yumi we're talking about.
lines.zh: 我怎么突然觉得有必要这么诗意？我们说的可是 Yumi 啊。

lines.en: : Yumi, let me in. I’m having a potentially uncharacteristic inner-monologue.
lines.zh: : Yumi，让我进去。我正在经历一段可能不太像我的内心独白。

lines.en: : Huh? The fuck are you talkin’ about? Get the hell out of here.
lines.zh: : 哈？你在他妈的说什么？给我滚出去。

lines.en: : You know I’m not going to do that. Just open the door.
lines.zh: : 你知道我不会走的。把门打开就行。

lines.en: : No! Fuck off!
lines.zh: : 不！滚蛋！

lines.en: "I hear something whack against the door and fall to the ground. She must have
lines.zh: 我听到什么东西砰地砸在门上、然后掉到地上。她多半是

lines.en: thrown her pillow at it."
lines.zh: 把枕头扔过来了。

lines.en: Or maybe a cushion. Who knows? Does it even matter?
lines.zh: 也可能是靠垫。谁知道呢？这重要吗？

lines.en: : Delivery for Yumi Yamaguchi.
lines.zh: : 给 Yumi Yamaguchi 的快递。

lines.en: : Oh my fucking God.
lines.zh: : 哦我操你的上帝。

lines.en: : I have the pizza you ordered.
lines.zh: : 我带着你点的披萨。

lines.en: : JESUS, OKAY! HOLD ON A FUCKING SECOND, WOULD YOU?
lines.zh: : 天——哪，好——吧！你他妈就不能等一下吗？！

lines.en: "I can hear the springs in her mattress squeak as she gets off the bed. I doubt
lines.zh: 我听见她床垫里的弹簧咯吱作响——她从床上下来了。我觉得她

lines.en: she was going to sleep this early, so maybe she was just lounging around or something?"
lines.zh: 不至于这么早就要睡，所以也许她只是闲躺着之类的？

lines.en: scene black
After a moment, the door opens and Yumi begrudgingly lets me in.
lines.zh: 过了一会儿，门开了，Yumi 不情不愿地让我进去。

lines.en: scene yumifirstdorm1
: What?...
: You look really cute.
lines.zh: : 你看起来真可爱。

lines.en: scene yumifirstdorm2
: Bullshit! I do not! It’s just a track jacket and pants. Do you have some...weird fetish for overly-clothed girls or something?!
lines.zh: : 放屁！才不是！不过是件运动外套加运动裤罢了。你是有什么……对穿得太多的女孩的奇怪癖好还是怎么的？！

lines.en: : You shouldn't belittle people for their fetishes, Yumi. It's unbecoming.
lines.zh: : Yumi，你不该因为别人的癖好而贬低人家。这可不体面。

lines.en: : I'll do whatever the fuck I want, thank you very much. Now why are you here?
lines.zh: : 我爱干什么就干什么，多谢关心。说吧，你来这儿干嘛？

lines.en: : Are you going to try to get me to talk to you again? Cause I’m not really in a talkin’ mood right now.
lines.zh: : 你又想让我跟你说话？因为我现在真没心情说话。

lines.en: : Did something happen?
lines.zh: : 出什么事了吗？

lines.en: scene yumifirstdorm3
: Yeah. This weird guy keeps followin’ me around and I’m pretty sure he’s going to [rape] me.
lines.zh: : 是啊。有个奇怪的家伙一直跟着我，我敢肯定他打算[rape]我。

lines.en: : That sounds horrible. Where did he go? I’ll take him down.
lines.zh: : 听起来糟透了。他去哪儿了？我去把他摆平。

lines.en: Of course I know she’s talking about me. But if she was actually concerned about me doing something horrible to her, why would she have opened the door in the first place?
lines.zh: 我当然知道她说的是我。可如果她真的担心我会对她做出什么可怕的事，那她一开始为什么要开门呢？

lines.en: : Relax. You're safe here.
lines.zh: : 放松点。你在这儿很安全。

lines.en: : I'd sure fucking hope so. It's {i}my{/i} room.
lines.zh: : 我他妈当然希望如此。这是{i}我的{/i}房间。

lines.en: : Though, I guess you've proven you really don't give a shit about that so far.
lines.zh: : 不过，我想你已经证明了，你根本他妈不在乎这个。

lines.en: scene yumifirstdorm2
: So, what's the plan? Are we going to sit here in silence for the rest of the night and stare at each other?
lines.zh: : 那么，有什么打算？我们要就这么一言不发地坐到天亮，大眼瞪小眼吗？

lines.en: : You know, if you're bored, you can leave whenever the fuck you want. It’s not like I actually want you here or anything.
lines.zh: : 你猜怎么着，你要是觉得无聊，随时他妈的可以走。又不是我真想让你在这儿什么的。

lines.en: : Woah, calm down there, tsundere. You’re about to confine yourself to a particular archetype.
lines.zh: : 哇哦，冷静点，傲娇。你快要把自己框进某个固定套路里了。

lines.en: scene yumifirstdorm4
: I’m not a fucking tsundere! I genuinely {i}do not{/i} want you here! I was about to go to sleep!
lines.zh: : 我才不是什么该死的傲娇！我是真的{i}不想{/i}你在这儿！我正准备睡觉呢！

lines.en: : Sleep? But it’s only 8PM. Chika’s not even home yet.
lines.zh: : 睡觉？可现在才晚上八点。Chika 都还没回家呢。

lines.en: : Well, what else was I gonna do?! I don’t have a laptop to fuck around with and I can’t figure out the password to Chika’s!
lines.zh: : 那我还能干嘛？！我又没有笔记本电脑可以瞎折腾，Chika 的密码我又猜不出来！

lines.en: : I thought about goin’ for a walk or whatever but then I figured that’s what {i}you{/i} would be doin’ since you’re apparently obsessed with stalking me now.
lines.zh: : 我想过出去走走什么的，可后{i}来{/i}一琢磨，你大概也正打算干这个，毕竟你现在显然迷上了跟踪我。

lines.en: : But now you’re here anyway so I obviously made the wrong decision!
lines.zh: : 结果你还是来了，所以很明显我做错了决定！

lines.en: : We can go for a walk if you want. Is there anywhere you want to go?
lines.zh: : 如果你想的话，我们可以去散步。有什么想去的地方吗？

lines.en: scene yumifirstdorm1
: No...ugh. We can just...fucking stay here...
lines.zh: : 不……唉。我们就……他妈的待在这儿吧……

lines.en: : I’m already in my pajamas. I don’t want to get dressed again.
lines.zh: : 我已经换好睡衣了。我不想再穿回外出的衣服。

lines.en: : I might get attacked.
lines.zh: : 我可能会被袭击。

lines.en: To be frank, I'm already having a hard time not {i}attacking{/i} her.
lines.zh: 说实话，我已经很难忍住不去{i}袭击{/i}她了。

lines.en: But this is also my first time seeing Yumi in her pajamas, so I think I should be forgiven for any impure thoughts I may or may not be having.
lines.zh: 但这也是我第一次看到 Yumi 穿睡衣的样子，所以我觉得，不管我有没有在动歪念头，都该被原谅。

lines.en: Sure, the words “Fuck You” are still looming in the background on her dry-erase board, but I feel like Yumi’s actually a little calmer today than usual.
lines.zh: 没错，她那块白板上“操你的”几个字还在背景里阴魂不散，可我觉得 Yumi 今天确实比平时稍微平静一点。

lines.en: : I guess we’ll stay here then. Do you want to, like...watch a movie or something?
lines.zh: : 那我们就待在这儿吧。你想不想，比如……看个电影什么的？

lines.en: : How? I just fuckin’ told you I don’t have the password to Chika’s laptop.
lines.zh: : 怎么看？我他妈刚跟你说过，我不知道 Chika 笔记本的密码。

lines.en: scene yumifirstdorm4
: Also, stop pretending we’re friends just because I let you inside my room!
lines.zh: : 还有，别因为我让你进了我的房间，就假装我们是朋友！

lines.en: scene yumifirstdorm5
I direct my attention to a bunch of old-looking TVs on a warehouse-style shelf near the door.
lines.zh: 我把注意力转向门边一个仓库式货架上堆着的几台看起来很旧的电视机。

lines.en: I’m not sure why either of these things are here, but I’m assuming at least one of the TVs needs to work, right?...
lines.zh: 我不明白这两样东西为什么会在这儿，不过我猜至少得有一台电视能看，对吧？……

lines.en: : Why do you have all of these?
lines.zh: : 你为什么会有这么多这东西？

lines.en: : What’s it matter to you?
lines.zh: : 跟你有什么关系？

lines.en: : Just...seems like a strange thing to collect.
lines.zh: : 只是……收集这玩意儿听起来挺奇怪的。

lines.en: scene yumifirstdorm6
: I’m not fuckin’ collecting ‘em! I sell these!
lines.zh: : 我他妈才不是在收集！我是拿去卖的！

lines.en: : Who in their right mind is buying old TVs from you?
lines.zh: : 哪个脑子正常的人会跟你买旧电视？

lines.en: : I don’t know! Pawn shops...old people like you tryin’ to remember their childhood. Whoever!
lines.zh: : 我怎么知道！当铺……像你这种想回忆童年的老东西。管他呢！

lines.en: : Aren’t there easier ways to earn money, though?
lines.zh: : 可就没有更轻松的赚钱方式吗？

lines.en: scene yumifirstdorm7
: What, like getting an actual job? Isn’t that off limits for students?
lines.zh: : 什么，比如找份正经工作？学生不是不准打工吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, but that hasn’t really stopped anybody else.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可这也没真拦住别人啊。

lines.en: : Okay, but who the fuck is gonna hire somebody like me? You know the way I talk.
lines.zh: : 行啊，可谁他妈会雇我这样的人？你知道我说话什么样。

lines.en: : I’m not workin’ material. I {i}have{/i} to do shit like this or I can’t afford to eat.
lines.zh: : 我不是打工的料。我{i}得{/i}干这些破事，不然就没钱吃饭。

lines.en: : Your parents don’t give you money for food?
lines.zh: : 你父母不给你饭钱吗？

lines.en: : I don’t really talk to my parents. Fuck them.
lines.zh: : 我不怎么跟我父母说话。去他妈的。

lines.en: scene yumifirstdorm6
: They’re assholes anyway! Maybe even worse than you! Who needs ‘em?
lines.zh: : 反正他们都是混蛋！说不定比你还混蛋！谁稀罕他们？

lines.en: : Besides, it’s not like I’m fuckin' starving or whatever. I still eat pretty much every day.
lines.zh: : 再说，我又不是在挨饿什么的。我基本上每天都还能吃上饭。

lines.en: : Pretty much?
lines.zh: : 基本上？

lines.en: scene yumifirstdorm8
: Well, yeah. You don’t need to eat {i}every{/i} day. All you really {i}need{/i} is water.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是啊。人又不是非得{i}天天{/i}吃饭。你真正{i}需要{/i}的只有水。

lines.en: : Is that why you have so many water bottles on your side of the room?
lines.zh: : 所以你那半边房间才有那么多水瓶？

lines.en: scene yumifirstdorm6
: Sh-shut up! They’re all empty! I just didn’t feel like cleanin’ em up!
lines.zh: : 闭、闭嘴！都是空的！我只是懒得收拾！

lines.en: : I walked all over town today and my legs are fuckin’ dead, so forgive me for not gettin' rid of some stupid bottles.
lines.zh: : 我今天在镇上走了一整天，腿都他妈要断了，所以原谅我没去扔几个破瓶子。

lines.en: : I didn't mention that it was a mess...I just noticed there was a lot of water, that’s all.
lines.zh: : 我又没说这里很乱……我只是注意到水挺多的，就这样。

lines.en: scene yumifirstdorm7
: Well...whatever. You said you wanted to know shit about me and now you know one thing. Is that enough for you to fuck off?
lines.zh: : 行……随你。你不是说想知道我的事吗，现在你知道一件了。够不够让你滚蛋了？

lines.en: : No, actually. In fact, I’m probably even more worried about you now.
lines.zh: : 不，还不够。事实上，我现在可能更担心你了。

lines.en: scene yumifirstdorm9
: The fuck is there to worry about?! I’m fine!
lines.zh: : 有什么他妈好担心的？！我好得很！

lines.en: : You’re most definitely not fine. You’re malnourished and I’m pretty sure it’s causing your attitude to deteriorate.
lines.zh: : 你绝对算不上好。你营养不良，而且我敢肯定，这正是你脾气越来越糟的原因。

lines.en: scene yumifirstdorm7
: That’s just my fuckin' attitude...What I eat has nothin’ to do with it.
lines.zh: : 那就是我他妈的脾气……跟我吃什么没关系。

lines.en: : If you really wanna help, just buy a fuckin’ TV.
lines.zh: : 你要是真想帮忙，就去买台该死的电视。

lines.en: : Where do you even get the TVs?
lines.zh: : 你到底从哪儿弄来这些电视的？

lines.en: scene yumifirstdorm9
: My God! The questions never end with you! Does it matter?!
lines.zh: : 我的天！你的问题没完没了是吧！这重要吗？！

lines.en: : Maybe I find ‘em on the side of the road! Maybe I steal ‘em! As long as it’s puttin’ food on the table, it shouldn’t fuckin' matter where they come from.
lines.zh: : 也许是我在路边捡的！也许是我偷的！只要能让我有饭吃，它们从哪儿来的就他妈不该重要。

lines.en: : I think you and I might need to do some job-hunting soon, Yumi.
lines.zh: : Yumi，我觉得你和我可能得尽快去找找工作了。

lines.en: scene yumifirstdorm10
: Yeah, well I think you should eat a fucking dick.
lines.zh: : 是啊，那我觉得你该去吃一根鸡巴。

lines.en: : Harsh.
lines.zh: : 真狠。

lines.en: : For real, though. Let’s try and figure out a way for you to be able to make ends meet without stealing or scavenging outdated television sets and-
lines.zh: : 不过说真的。我们想想办法，让你不用靠偷、靠捡过时的电视机也能维持生计——

lines.en: : What’s all that other stuff on the desk? Candy?
lines.zh: : 桌上那些别的东西是什么？糖？

lines.en: scene yumifirstdorm7
: Yeah...Easier to sell, but doesn’t bring in as much cash.
lines.zh: : 嗯……好卖一些，但赚不了那么多钱。

lines.en: : Not like I can survive off just eatin’ candy either, so none of that's for me.
lines.zh: : 再说我也不能光靠吃糖活着，所以那些不是给我自己吃的。

lines.en: : Okay well, either way, I’ll try and help you find some work.
lines.zh: : 好吧，不管怎样，我都会帮你找点活儿干。

lines.en: : ...If you think I’m gonna suck your dick in exchange for helping me out or whatever, you’re fucking delusional. It’s not gonna happen.
lines.zh: : ……你要是觉得我会为了报答你之类的去给你口交，那你他妈是妄想。不可能的。

lines.en: : I didn’t even almost insinuate that.
lines.zh: : 我连那个边都没沾上。

lines.en: scene yumifirstdorm6
: You don’t need to. You’ve made your motives pretty clear already, asshole.
lines.zh: : 你不用。你的动机已经够明显的了，混蛋。

lines.en: : I just want you to be able to eat every day instead of “pretty much” every day.
lines.zh: : 我只是想让你能每天都吃上饭，而不是“基本上”每天都吃上。

lines.en: : Sure, you might hate my guts, but you’re still my student.
lines.zh: : 没错，你也许恨透了我，可你还是我的学生。

lines.en: : I might not be the best teacher out there-
lines.zh: : 我可能算不上最好的老师——

lines.en: : {i}Might{/i} not be?
lines.zh: : {i}可能{/i}算不上？

lines.en: : Okay. I'm {i}definitely not{/i} the best teacher out there, but I do know that I’m not supposed to let my students die of starvation.
lines.zh: : 好吧。我{i}绝对算不上{/i}最好的老师，但我确实知道，我不该让自己的学生饿死。

lines.en: scene yumifirstdorm7
: You really did get this job just to hang around [young_girls], didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 你拿到这份工作，真的就只是为了混在[young_girls]身边，对吧？

lines.en: : The answer to that question is very complicated, so I am going to disregard it. The point is, we’re going to start the Yumi Revitalization Project.
lines.zh: : 这个问题的答案非常复杂，所以我打算忽略它。重点是，我们要启动「Yumi 复兴计划」了。

lines.en: scene yumifirstdorm11
: Heh?
: The Yumi-what now?
lines.zh: : 「Yumi 什么」计划？

lines.en: : The Yumi Revitalization Project. Coming soon to a Yumi near you.
lines.zh: : 「Yumi 复兴计划」。即将降临到你身边的 Yumi 身上。

lines.en: : Are you high?
lines.zh: : 你嗑药了？

lines.en: : High on passion.
lines.zh: : 嗑的是激情。

lines.en: : You’re a fucking lunatic.
lines.zh: : 你他妈是个疯子。

lines.en: : I never agreed to this.
lines.zh: : 我可从来没同意过。

lines.en: : You don’t need to agree to it. I’ve decided this is best for you as your teacher.
lines.zh: : 你不需要同意。作为你的老师，我已经决定了这对你最好。

lines.en: : And if you disagree, I’ll report all of your absences to the principal.
lines.zh: : 如果你不同意，我就把你所有的缺勤都报告给校长。

lines.en: scene yumifirstdorm12
: Wait...You mean...you haven’t already been doing that?
lines.zh: : 等等……你是说……你之前一直没那么做？

lines.en: : Of course not. I don’t want you to fail.
lines.zh: : 当然没有。我不想你不及格。

lines.en: There’s also the issue of me being held responsible if I report that she’s skipping literally every day, so...
lines.zh: 另外还有个问题：如果我报告她天天都在逃课，我自己也得担责任，所以……

lines.en: scene yumifirstdorm8
: Uhh...I don’t really know what I’m supposed to say to that.
lines.zh: : 呃……我真不知道该说什么。

lines.en: : Thanks...I guess?
lines.zh: : 谢了……大概吧。

lines.en: : That’s...actually really cool of you.
lines.zh: : 那……还真是挺够意思的。

lines.en: : No need to thank me - just looking out for you. What
lines.zh: 「不用谢——只是替你着想。不过你能做的，是

lines.en: you can do, though, is sign this contract here..."
lines.zh: 在这份合同上签个字……」

lines.en: "I remove a sheet of receipt paper and a pen from my pocket and
lines.zh: 我从口袋里掏出一张收据纸和一支笔，

lines.en: quickly scribble the words “Yumi Revitalization Project” on it."
lines.zh: 飞快地在上面潦草地写下「Yumi 复兴计划」几个字。

lines.en: "I add an extra blank line underneath the subtotal for a purchase at the cafe
lines.zh: 我在小计下面多加了一行空白——那是在咖啡馆的一笔消费——

lines.en: and hand the sheet over to Yumi."
lines.zh: 然后把纸递给了 Yumi。

lines.en: scene yumifirstdorm11
: The fuck, dude? This is a receipt for coffee.
lines.zh: : 什么鬼，老兄？这是一张咖啡收据。

lines.en: : I’m supposed to sign away my freedom on {i}this{/i}?
lines.zh: : 你要我在{i}这个{/i}上面签掉我的自由？

lines.en: : You’re not signing away your freedom. You’re just agreeing to go job hunting with me.
lines.zh: : 你不是签掉自由。你只是同意跟我一起去找工作。

lines.en: scene yumifirstdorm10
: But...what if they don’t like me? I don’t really have the best reputation around here...
lines.zh: : 可……万一他们不喜欢我呢？我在这边的名声可不怎么好……

lines.en: : Then we’ll just find somewhere else.
lines.zh: : 那我们就换个别的地方。

lines.en: : I’ll even buy you lunch or something whenever we go out. Free food doesn’t sound bad, right?
lines.zh: : 我们每次出去，我还可以请你吃个午饭什么的。免费的食物听起来不赖吧？

lines.en: : Doesn’t sound that good either if it’s coming from you...Who knows what you’ll ask me to
lines.zh: 「换作是你给的，听起来也没那么好……谁知道你以后会要我

lines.en: do to ‘repay my debt’ or whatever the fuck you’re eventually gonna call it."
lines.zh: 做什么来‘还债’，或者随便你他妈怎么称呼它。」

lines.en: : Your happiness is more than enough payment for me, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 你的幸福对我来说已经是足够的报酬了，Yumi。

lines.en: scene yumifirstdorm11
: Gross...
lines.zh: : 恶心……

lines.en: : Yeah. That was hard to say.
lines.zh: : 是啊。这句话说起来可真难。

lines.en: : Ugh...whatever. Fine.
lines.zh: : 呃……算了。行吧。

lines.en: scene yumifirstdorm10
: Free lunch doesn’t sound that bad anyway. And if I have a chance at gettin’ more money out of it, then...
lines.zh: : 反正免费午餐听起来也不差。而且要是能顺便多弄点钱，那么……

lines.en: : I guess I can stomach bein' near you a little more...
lines.zh: : 我想我可以再稍微忍受一下待在你旁边……

lines.en: scene black
Yumi scribbles her name on the sheet of receipt paper and hands it back to me.
lines.zh: Yumi 在收据纸上潦草地签下自己的名字，把它递还给我。

lines.en: I try and stay for a while longer to chat with her about other things, but she manages to push me out of the room.
lines.zh: 我试着再待一会儿，跟她聊聊别的事，可她还是把我推出了房间。

lines.en: Eventually, I find myself walking back home. But not without a newly-formed contract between myself and the[school]-delinquent.
lines.zh: 最终，我踏上了回家的路。只不过手上多了一份我和这个[school]不良少女之间新签下的合同。

lines.en: Here’s to hoping we can get her onto the right track soon enough.
lines.zh: 但愿我们能尽快把她引上正轨。

lines.en: Kudos to me for actually being a teacher for once.
lines.zh: 敬我自己一次——这次总算真的当了一回老师。

lines.en: $ yumidorm10 = True
$ yumi_love += 1
{i}Yumi’s affection has {s}somehow{/s} increased to [yumi_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Yumi 的好感度不知怎么地提升到了 [yumi_love]!{/i}

lines.en: {i}You can now spend time with her in her room!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你现在可以去她的房间陪她了！{/i}

jump endofweekday
